items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: Laurie Russell, our Alumni Affairs honcho, to arrange... I announced this to the members of the band

ctx.x: Yeah. And you guys do have fun.

We have fun, and the band is a bunch of humorists. They’re very, very funny. I’ve played in many bands, Monk, over the years. This bunch, every one of them is a live wire. They’re funny. We exchange emails and mailings and they’re always hilarious, on any subject. For instance, Donny Andre, our banjoist, wanted to be sure that when we take up our residence for this next few days in an ex-fraternity house, that we would each have a private bathroom. And by George that was very difficult for Laurie Russell, our…
Do you happen to have this poem memorized?
